_about: Project specifics for the sluice. The hooks, scripts, skills and agents read anything project- or model-specific from this file only. The bootstrap (install/BOOTSTRAP.md) fills in the empty fields.
_projectNotesNote: This project's knowledge for the sluice's agents: review lenses, verification methods, rules worth quoting. The planner, reviewer, auditor and fixer read it. Keep it under about 800 words: it's re-read on every call. Created by the bootstrap from templates; never overwritten by an upgrade.
_gateNote: The fast checks a builder, fixer or clerk (gateRoles) must pass before it may finish: typically typecheck, lint, unit tests. Each runs in a shell from the project root. Keep the total under about a minute.
_lockedNote: Commands that share a build folder or port, so parallel agents must take turns (via with-lock.sh).
_healthNote: The code-health snapshot (health.mjs) in every block note and the scoreboard. extensions, include and exclude (path prefixes) choose the source files; an empty include means all tracked files. commands are project measures that print one line, e.g. a complexity count from the linter. Set "health": "off" to skip it.
_viewsNote: The views (visualize.mjs): Markdown with Mermaid, redrawn by the hooks into <progressDir>/<tranche>/<dir>/ for a preview left open beside a run. Gitignore that folder; --freeze <block> writes a committed copy to snapshots/. Set "views": "off" to skip them.
_pricesNote: List prices in USD per million tokens, by model family. Used only to compare runs and convert spend to windows, never as a bill. Update with docs/design.md §14.
_windowNote: List-price-equivalent spend one 5-hour usage window held in the case study. A starting guess: re-estimate it after your first block from the statusline's percentages.
